compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
~110 direct ambient `os.getenv`/`os.environ`/`load_config` reads (plus backend property reloads and configurable adapter defaults) currently sit BELOW the approved composition seams across the reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, and the MCP server. RP-04 is not complete while these legacy ambient reads can return values inconsistently under an in-progress operation or bypass the central seam. The ownership gate's initial legacy-exception set (slice C1) must reach EMPTY. This slice also carries the MCP `mcp_server` `load_config()`-per-call cutover deferred from RP-04 S5.

## Outcome
Every below-seam ambient config/credential read, backend reload, and configurable adapter default is either cut to compose through the approved seam (operation snapshot / startup binding / provider boundary) or, for genuine test-only controls and protocol constants, registered with an exact `path+symbol+rationale` entry. The ownership gate then passes on the real tree with an EMPTY legacy-exception set. Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions are removed only after their focused suites pass. All S1-S6 behavioral suites remain green and provider-neutral outcomes are unchanged (approved deltas recorded).

## Plan
1. Iterate subsystem-by-subsystem (reconciler engine; store/snapshot/io; cli/commands; llm/workflow; mcp_server/_mcp_auth). For each below-seam read: cut-to-seam OR register with rationale.
2. Drain the legacy-exception set to empty; remove legacy facades/switches only after each subsystem's suite passes.
3. Record redacted snapshot-fingerprint / provider-neutral outcome comparisons and any approved behavior delta.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
- The ownership gate (C1) passes on the REAL tree with an EMPTY legacy-exception set and no path-glob exceptions.
- All S1-S6 behavioral suites pass after each subsystem cutover and after legacy-facade removal (they are the correctness oracle; the AST gate supplements them).
- Redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes before/after are equal except for explicitly recorded, justified deltas.

## Compatibility / rollback
Do not remove a legacy facade until its focused suite and bounded path pass; before removal, rollback selects the facade. At contract phase, retain only the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor; rollback below it is unsupported and documented. Stored ticket/event/bridge/binding formats are unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The real tree has no direct ambient config/credential read, backend reload, or configurable adapter default below approved seams; every declared config/credential name has one owner; the legacy exception set is EMPTY; no exception uses a path glob.
- [ ] All S1-S6 behavioral suites pass after legacy removal; redacted fingerprints/provider-neutral outcomes are unchanged except for recorded approved deltas.
- [ ] Legacy facades, switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions are removed only after their proof passes; documented rollback retains the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Bounded provider, AWS review-bot/op-cert, and reconciler check/dry-run/live canaries pass with required redacted evidence (run/change ids, timestamps, selected provider/auth-source kind, retry/cache counters, redacted fingerprint/outcome, rollback decision) and no unauthorized fallback or leakage.
